prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sunlit arches of the Roman Colosseum with worn stone paving, standard-height arched doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Thai woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver square-sided cowbell, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper miniature anvil, a lead small flared temple bell, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three rose-gold anklets. Extremely long round nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries a dense printed-circuit surface grown over her skin, raised copper traces and solder pads running in tidy right-angled lines over every curve, tiny rectangles of black silicon chips set into the surface, BLAZING glossy white ceramic circuit-board surface with silver traces, VIVID magenta light pulses racing along the traces and small glowing LED points. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Chinese man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth light skin with a warm golden undertone, a calm gentle gaze, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver round bell, a copper square-sided cowbell, a tin barrel-shaped weight, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a lead small flared temple bell, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold square-sided cowbell, a tin round bell, a bronze barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold rings. Extra long nails in matching polished rosewood.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body deep purple-brown rosewood carved directly over his own form wrapping his whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid carved wood curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep purple-brown rosewood grain across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID near-black streaks running between the carved sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. His face and ears are real living skin, and his neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and his shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved deep purple-brown rosewood.

RIGHT Cracks: the deep purple-brown rosewood body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across his right upper arm, and two chipped-off pieces, one at his left thigh and one at his left shoulder, where the broken edge reveals the pale raw fresh wood with a rough splintered grain, much lighter than the dark polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including his chest, the deep purple-brown rosewood is smooth, polished and whole, and his face, ears and neck are living skin.
RIGHT Pose: standing with both arms relaxed at his sides, palms turned slightly forward, head tilted a little.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme strappy platform stiletto sandals in tan leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with his legs and ankles staying solid carved deep purple-brown rosewood right down to the shoes.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
